Daniel Heuer Fernandes has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

79' Daniel Heuer Fernandes pulls off a great save to deny Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the top left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! Louis Oppie (St. Pauli) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
77' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

77' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net but Daniel Heuer Fernandes keeps it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to St. Pauli.

77' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) was too forceful with his tackle and Tobias Welz interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to St. Pauli, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
